name: ai-agent-memory-systems
description: Use when the user asks about agent memory, long-term memory across sessions, remembering user preferences, context window full, conversation summarization, episodic or semantic memory. Produces memory tiers, a store schema and write/retrieve/expiry policies with per-user isolation. Not for document RAG (use llm-rag-retrieval-internals) or vector DB operations (use data-vector-databases).
